objects.name: The Toll-Light
objects.vInscr: The toll here was paid in teeth. The box is full.

landmarks.name: The Unshod Waymark
landmarks.inscription: Past this stone the road was held too holy for shoes. The shoes are waiting still.

landmarks.name: The Bound Oathwright
landmarks.inscription: They tied their god to the tree so it could not leave them. It did not leave. It did not answer either.

landmarks.name: The Deposed Sovereign
landmarks.inscription: They crowned the god to make of it a king. A king can be pulled down.

landmarks.name: She of the Six Gifts
landmarks.inscription: Each hand held out one gift. The faithful broke off the two they could no longer bear to be given.
